exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: How often do you buy things online? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: What was the last thing you bought online?

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Do you ever see things in shops and then buy them online? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 5
exercises.prompt: Do you think the popularity of online shopping is changing your town or city centre? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a time when you enjoyed visiting a member of your family in their home. You should say: who you visited and where they lived why you made this visit what happened during this visit and explain what you enjoyed about this visit.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: When do families celebrate together in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: How often do all the generations in a family come together in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Why is it that some people might not enjoy attending family occasions?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Do you think it is a good thing for parents to help their children with schoolwork?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 7
exercises.prompt: How important do you think it is for families to eat together at least once a day?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 8
exercises.prompt: Do you believe that everyone in a family should share household tasks?
